استشكلتا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْكَلَتَا (istaškalatā) /is.taʃ.ka.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اُسْتُشْكِلَتَا (ustuškilatā) /us.tuʃ.ki.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
